mapper.select: SELECT shop_id FROM cere_platform_shop where shop_name=#{shopName}
SELECT shop_id FROM cere_platform_shop where shop_phone=#{shopPhone}
SELECT shop_id FROM cere_platform_shop where shop_name=#{shopName} and shop_id!= #{shopId}
SELECT shop_id FROM cere_platform_shop where shop_phone=#{shopPhone} and shop_id!= #{shopId}

SELECT a.business_user_id from cere_platform_business a LEFT JOIN cere_business_shop b ON a.business_user_id=b.business_user_id LEFT JOIN cere_platform_shop c ON b.shop_id=c.shop_id where c.shop_id=#{shopId}

SELECT a.shop_id, a.shop_code, a.shop_name, a.shop_brief, a.shop_phone, a.shop_password, a.charge_person_name, a.charge_person_phone, a.shop_adress, a.effective_date, a.effective_year, a.contract_state, a.authentication_state, a.check_state, a.`state`, a.authen_type, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.audit_live, a.audit_live_product, a.hot_flag, b.business_user_id FROM cere_platform_shop a, cere_platform_business b where a.charge_person_phone = b.phone and shop_id = #{shopId}

SELECT a.shop_id, a.shop_name, a.shop_code, a.charge_person_name, a.charge_person_phone, a.state, a.create_time, a.contract_state, a.hot_flag FROM cere_platform_shop a
and shop_name like concat('%',#{shopName},'%')
and shop_code like concat('%',#{shopCode},'%')
and charge_person_name like concat('%',#{chargePersonName},'%')
and contract_state=#{contractState}
order by create_time desc

mapper.select:
SELECT a.shop_id,a.shop_name,a.shop_code,ifnull(b.revenue, 0) as revenue from cere_platform_shop a LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(price) revenue,shop_id from cere_shop_order where state IN(2,3,4) GROUP BY shop_id) b ON a.shop_id=b.shop_id
and a.shop_name like concat('%',#{shopName},'%')
and a.shop_code like concat('%',#{shopCode},'%')

SELECT IF(SUM(price) IS NULL,0,SUM(price)) FROM cere_shop_order where state IN(2,3)
and shop_id=#{shopId}

SELECT IF(SUM(money) IS NULL,0,SUM(money)) FROM cere_order_reconciliation a LEFT JOIN cere_shop_order b ON a.order_id=b.order_id where a.type=2
and b.shop_id=#{shopId}
SELECT IF(SUM(price) IS NULL,0,SUM(price)) FROM cere_shop_order where state IN(2,3,4)
SELECT IF(SUM(price) IS NULL,0,SUM(price)) FROM cere_shop_order where state=4
SELECT IF(SUM(withdrawal_money) IS NULL,0,SUM(withdrawal_money)) FROM cere_shop_withdrawal where state=0

SELECT a.business_user_id FROM cere_platform_business a LEFT JOIN cere_business_shop b ON a.business_user_id=b.business_user_id LEFT JOIN cere_platform_shop c ON b.shop_id=c.shop_id where c.shop_id=#{shopId}
SELECT * FROM cere_platform_business where business_user_id=#{businessUserId}
SELECT * FROM cere_platform_shop where check_state=1 and state=1
SELECT IF(SUM(withdrawal_money) IS NULL,0,SUM(withdrawal_money)) FROM cere_shop_withdrawal where shop_id = #{shopId} and state = 0

select a.shop_id, shop_name, shop_logo, count(*) as cnt from cere_shop_visit a join cere_platform_shop b on b.shop_id = a.shop_id where visit_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 1 month) group by a.shop_id order by cnt desc limit 5
